tools.name: gribstream_build_runs_request
tools.description: NO AUTH / PUBLIC / READ-ONLY. Builds and validates a copy-pasteable authenticated /api/v2/{dataset}/runs HTTP request without sending it. This tool does not execute the request, query weather values, or return forecast data. Use gribstream_query_runs when the user asks for actual model-run forecast

tools.name: gribstream_build_timeseries_request
tools.description: NO AUTH / PUBLIC / READ-ONLY. Builds and validates a copy-pasteable authenticated /api/v2/{dataset}/timeseries HTTP request without sending it. This tool does not execute the request, query weather values, or return forecast data. Use gribstream_query_timeseries when the user asks for actual weather

tools.name: gribstream_get_dataset
tools.description: NO AUTH / PUBLIC / READ-ONLY. Gets full public metadata for one dataset code, including archive coverage, cadence, tags, source links, and members. This tool does not query weather values and cannot return forecast data.

tools.name: gribstream_get_expression_reference
tools.description: NO AUTH / PUBLIC / READ-ONLY. Gets the GribStream expression language reference, including github.com/expr-lang/expr syntax guidance, alias rules, examples, and the full exported func.* math function list. This tool does not query weather values and cannot return forecast data.

tools.name: gribstream_get_parameter
tools.description: NO AUTH / PUBLIC / READ-ONLY. Gets detailed metadata and exact selector variations for one already-known dataset-native parameter code. Parameter codes are case-sensitive. For a common natural-language concept such as 2 metre temperature, use gribstream_resolve_shared_parameter before guessing a nat

tools.name: gribstream_list_datasets
tools.description: NO AUTH / PUBLIC / READ-ONLY. Lists public GribStream datasets and metadata. This tool does not query weather values and cannot return forecast data. Supports catalog filters such as code, family, tag, and is_ensemble.

tools.name: gribstream_list_parameters
tools.description: NO AUTH / PUBLIC / READ-ONLY. Lists parameter summaries for one dataset. Use this before selecting exact case-sensitive parameter codes. This tool does not query weather values and cannot return forecast data.

tools.name: gribstream_list_shared_parameters
tools.description: NO AUTH / PUBLIC / READ-ONLY. Lists normalized shared parameter presets that can map one logical signal across datasets. Use this only when the shared parameter code is uncertain; when a common code such as temperature_2m is already clear, call gribstream_resolve_shared_parameter directly. This tool

tools.name: gribstream_query_runs
tools.description: AUTH REQUIRED / DATA QUERY. Executes an authenticated /api/v2/{dataset}/runs request and returns actual weather/forecast data values across model runs. Use this tool, not the NO AUTH request-building or metadata tools, when the user asks to fetch, retrieve, download, return, or analyze model-run his

tools.name: gribstream_query_timeseries
tools.description: AUTH REQUIRED / DATA QUERY. Executes an authenticated /api/v2/{dataset}/timeseries request and returns actual weather/forecast data values. Use this tool, not the NO AUTH request-building or metadata tools, when the user asks to fetch, retrieve, download, return, or analyze weather values, CSV/JSON/

tools.name: gribstream_resolve_shared_parameter
tools.description: NO AUTH / PUBLIC / READ-ONLY. Resolves one shared parameter preset for a dataset, returning native variables and expressions to use in /timeseries or /runs request bodies. Use this first for common natural-language concepts such as 2 metre temperature or 10 metre wind instead of guessing dataset-nat

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "gribstream_list_datasets" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gribstream_query_runs, gribstream_query_timeseries · Private data: gribstream_query_runs, gribstream_query_timeseries · Public sink: gribstream_build_runs_request, gribstream_build_timeseries_request · Destructive: gribstream_build_runs_request, gribstream_build_timeseries_request, gribstream_query_runs, gribstream_query_timeseries, gribstream_resolve_shared_parameter, gribstream_validate_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gribstream_query_runs, gribstream_query_timeseries · Private data: gribstream_query_runs, gribstream_query_timeseries · Public sink: gribstream_build_runs_request, gribstream_build_timeseries_request · Destructive: gribstream_build_runs_request, gribstream_build_timeseries_request, gribstream_query_runs, gribstream_query_timeseries, gribstream_resolve_shared_parameter, gribstream_validate_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
